The T6 → T7 transition. With the §9Intergalactic Upgrade Core§r in escrow (right-click the controller) and §9Star Chart: Triangulum§r in the slot, the Eye is PENDING and the magnetar keeps burning.

§5§lBEGIN§r
- Buffer the charge first:§9 18,432 L White Dwarf Matter§r and§9 4,608 L Black Dwarf Matter§r (× p), plus Triangulum's first cycle (7.5 L Magnetar Matter: keep at least 8 L).
- When Galaxy Transition [1] (ready) is on, §9Begin§r: the GUI's Galaxy panel, a rising edge on a Burst Control Hatch in Begin mode in a plinth d socket, or OpenComputers beginTransition().

§5§lPHASES§r
1. §9Overfeed§r, 5 min: White Dwarf Matter 61.44 and Black Dwarf Matter 15.36 L/s on top of the upkeep; Ω and Π wind up.
2. §9Collapse§r: a shock of P +120, minus 10 for every Bu/t (1e13 EU/t) above 1.5 that lands that second.
3. §9Halo capture§r, 10 min: Stable for 60 s in a row between 7:00 and 10:00. A minor merger comes at 7:30.

§5§lTHE §lSKILL §lMOVE§r Land an eruption on the collapse second. Galaxy Transition [8] holds your regulator's purges from T-80 s, and [4] says purge now (at T-80 s if the flux would erupt early, then from T-2 s: an eruption lasts 3 s, so wiring that answers within a second still lands it): wire (Disc [4] AND NOT [8]) OR [4] to the quasar's Burst Control Hatch and the eruption lands on the collapse.
- What it cancels is the quasar's stream: the whole shock needs§9 13.5 Bu/t§r (1.35e14 EU/t) on the Eye that second. A quasar whose best (a purge at full flux, 3.5 × G0 × the jet yield) falls short gets a §cred row§r above Begin and in the Galaxy panel, with the shock it would leave. Begin still works; grow the quasar first.

A failure loses the magnetar and keeps the core in escrow. Leave the chart in: the Eye re-spawns the magnetar (the Magnetar Merger's charge) and the collapse can run again, with no core and no link. Once T7 is unlocked a lost galaxy never comes back this way: it relights at Triangulum directly.

[note]The core is a Condensate Assembler recipe: Entangled Magnetar Matter, Antipolarization Agent, SpaceTime and Black Dwarf condensates, two Mk I throats and White Dwarf nanites. It is consumed only when the collapse succeeds.[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you hold the core and the chart (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL: claim before the core goes into escrow).
